limitations: Pre-execution simulation gate only; this is not a physical-flight safety guarantee.
Routes use a straight-line geometric baseline; trajectory optimization, active collision avoidance, weather, communications, and flight dynamics are not evaluated.

notes: The roadmap requires battery and altitude checks but does not state thresholds.
These values are explicit synthetic development assumptions, not legal limits, hardware specifications, or safety guarantees.
Restricted-area checks use a straight-line center-to-center route baseline against circular or polygonal blocked map records.
The 20 m inter-drone separation threshold is a synthetic software-simulation assumption, not a hardware specification.
Collision avoidance, weather, communications, and physical flight dynamics are not evaluated by this policy.
Week 5 deterministic scheduling simulation; not safety validation, route optimization, or execution.

limitations: Deterministic 2D kinematic interpolation; no aerodynamic or flight-controller dynamics.
Formation slots are static geometric deconfliction, not active collision avoidance.
Battery percentage is held constant because no battery-consumption model is specified.
Imagery capture and model inference are separate Week 8 stage artifacts.
